title: Delivery Ops - Print Production Level 2
description:
Candidates who receive an offer will be required to successfully complete a background check and drug test as a condition of employment.

Print Production/ Document Advisor
Linden, NJ
2+ Month Contract
8AM to 4:30PM and there are times where client will ask and approve OT

Primary Responsibilities:
Operate digital and color print equipment for document production.
Perform mailroom tasks: sorting, delivery, metering, and packaging of incoming/outgoing mail and packages.
Use finishing equipment such as laminators, paper cutters, and inserters.
Conduct basic troubleshooting and maintenance of office equipment.
Monitor job queues, perform quality checks, and log/report production activities.
Assist with file preparation, scanning, archiving, and electronic file management.
Interact professionally with clients and end-users; provide support and escalate issues as needed.
Maintain inventory levels and assist in ordering office/production supplies.
Participate in workflow optimization and continuous improvement initiatives.

Skills and Qualifications:
Basic to intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Strong organizational and multitasking skills in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to operate and maintain various print and mail equipment.
Clear communication skills and a customer service mindset.
Physical ability to lift up to 50 lbs and stand/walk for long periods.
Bilingual (English/French or other languages) preferred for some locations.

Education and Experience:
High School Diploma or equivalent required.
Minimum 1 year experience in a print, mail, or customer service role.
Post-secondary training in technology, office administration, or print production is a plus.

Metasys Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
